question: 1. Display employee name and department name.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, d.DNAME FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO;

question: 2. Display employee name, salary, and department location.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, e.SAL, d.LOC FROM EMP e, DEPT d WHERE e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO;

question: 3. Display employee name and department name for department 10.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, d.DNAME FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO WHERE e.DEPTNO = 10;

question: 4. Display employee name and department name where salary > 2000.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, d.DNAME FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO WHERE e.SAL > 2000;
output: JONES, BLAKE, CLARK, SCOTT, KING, FORD

question: 5. Display employee name, job, and department name.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, e.JOB, d.DNAME FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO;
output: Data combined from EMP and DEPT.

question: 6. Display employee name and department location for CLERKs.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, d.LOC FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO WHERE e.JOB = 'CLERK';

question: 7. Display employee name and department name working in NEW YORK.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, d.DNAME FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO WHERE d.LOC = 'NEW YORK';

question: 8. Display employee name, department number, and department name.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, d.DEPTNO, d.DNAME FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO;

question: 9. Display employees hired after 1981 with department name.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, d.DNAME FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO WHERE e.HIREDATE > '31-DEC-81';

question: 10. Display employees with commission along with department name.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, e.COMM, d.DNAME FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO WHERE e.COMM IS NOT NULL;

question: 11. Display employees whose salary is between 1500 and 3000 with department.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, d.DNAME FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO WHERE e.SAL BETWEEN 1500 AND 3000;

question: 12. Display employees who are the only employee in their department.
query: SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO IN (SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO HAVING COUNT(*) = 1);
output: No rows (Standard EMP has multiple per dept).

question: 13. Display employees whose department has more than 3 employees.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, d.DNAME FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO WHERE e.DEPTNO IN (SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO HAVING COUNT(*) > 3);

question: 14. Display departments where no employee earns more than 2000.
query: SELECT DNAME FROM DEPT WHERE DEPTNO NOT IN (SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP WHERE SAL > 2000);

question: 15. Display employees who earn more than at least one manager.
query: SELECT DISTINCT e.ENAME FROM EMP e WHERE e.SAL > ANY (SELECT SAL FROM EMP WHERE JOB = 'MANAGER');

question: 16. Display employees who share same job and department.
query: SELECT e1.ENAME, e1.JOB, e1.DEPTNO FROM EMP e1, EMP e2 WHERE e1.JOB = e2.JOB AND e1.DEPTNO = e2.DEPTNO AND e1.EMPNO != e2.EMPNO;

question: 17. Display employees working in same department as their manager.
query: SELECT e.ENAME FROM EMP e, EMP m WHERE e.MGR = m.EMPNO AND e.DEPTNO = m.DEPTNO;

question: 18. Display employees whose manager works in a different department.
query: SELECT e.ENAME FROM EMP e, EMP m WHERE e.MGR = m.EMPNO AND e.DEPTNO != m.DEPTNO;

question: 19. Display employees who are highest paid in their department.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, d.DNAME, e.SAL FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO WHERE (e.DEPTNO, e.SAL) IN (SELECT DEPTNO, MAX(SAL) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO);

question: 20. Display employees earning more than their department average.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, d.DNAME FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO WHERE e.SAL > (SELECT AVG(SAL) FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO = e.DEPTNO);

question: 21. Display department with maximum employees.
query: SELECT d.DNAME FROM DEPT d JOIN EMP e ON d.DEPTNO = e.DEPTNO GROUP BY d.DNAME HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(COUNT(*)) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO);

question: 22. Display department with highest total salary.
query: SELECT d.DNAME FROM DEPT d JOIN EMP e ON d.DEPTNO = e.DEPTNO GROUP BY d.DNAME HAVING SUM(e.SAL) = (SELECT MAX(SUM(SAL)) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO);

question: 23. Display department name and average salary.
query: SELECT d.DNAME, AVG(e.SAL) FROM DEPT d JOIN EMP e ON d.DEPTNO = e.DEPTNO GROUP BY d.DNAME;

question: 24. Display department name and total salary.
query: SELECT d.DNAME, SUM(e.SAL) FROM DEPT d JOIN EMP e ON d.DEPTNO = e.DEPTNO GROUP BY d.DNAME;

question: 25. Display department name and number of employees.
query: SELECT d.DNAME, COUNT(e.EMPNO) FROM DEPT d LEFT JOIN EMP e ON d.DEPTNO = e.DEPTNO GROUP BY d.DNAME;

question: 26. Display employees not assigned to any department.
query: SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO IS NULL;

question: 27. Display departments with no employees.
query: SELECT d.DNAME FROM DEPT d LEFT JOIN EMP e ON d.DEPTNO = e.DEPTNO WHERE e.EMPNO IS NULL;

question: 28. Display all departments with employees (Outer Join).
query: SELECT d.DNAME, e.ENAME FROM DEPT d LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP e ON d.DEPTNO = e.DEPTNO;
output: Shows all depts even with 0 employees.

question: 29. Display all employees with department name (Right Join).
query: SELECT e.ENAME, d.DNAME FROM DEPT d RIGHT OUTER JOIN EMP e ON d.DEPTNO = e.DEPTNO;

question: 30. Display employees whose manager works in department 10.
query: SELECT e.ENAME FROM EMP e WHERE e.MGR IN (SELECT EMPNO FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO = 10);

question: 31. Display employees working under the same manager (Self Join).
query: SELECT e1.ENAME, e2.ENAME AS COLLEAGUE FROM EMP e1, EMP e2 WHERE e1.MGR = e2.MGR AND e1.EMPNO < e2.EMPNO;

question: 32. Display employees earning more than their manager (Self Join).
query: SELECT e.ENAME FROM EMP e, EMP m WHERE e.MGR = m.EMPNO AND e.SAL > m.SAL;

question: 33. Display employee name and manager salary.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, m.SAL AS MGR_SAL FROM EMP e, EMP m WHERE e.MGR = m.EMPNO;

question: 34. Display employees who are managers.
query: SELECT DISTINCT m.ENAME FROM EMP e JOIN EMP m ON e.MGR = m.EMPNO;
output: JONES, BLAKE, CLARK, SCOTT, KING, FORD

question: 35. Display employees who do not have managers.
query: SELECT ENAME FROM EMP WHERE MGR IS NULL;

question: 36. Display employee name and manager name (Self Join).
query: SELECT e.ENAME AS EMP, m.ENAME AS MGR FROM EMP e LEFT JOIN EMP m ON e.MGR = m.EMPNO;

question: 37. Display employees whose department location is DALLAS.
query: SELECT e.ENAME FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO WHERE d.LOC = 'DALLAS';

question: 38. Display employees whose department is ACCOUNTING.
query: SELECT e.ENAME FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO WHERE d.DNAME = 'ACCOUNTING';

question: 39. Display employees not working in department 30 with department name.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, d.DNAME FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO WHERE e.DEPTNO != 30;

question: 40. Display employees whose job is MANAGER with department location.
query: SELECT e.ENAME, d.LOC FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO WHERE e.JOB = 'MANAGER';
output:
JONES | DALLAS
BLAKE | CHICAGO
CLARK | NEW YORK
